title: Uncraft Ice
description: This prject is fairly simple, it adds recipes to craft blue ice into compressed ice (packed ice) and compressed ice into ice. dont expect updates or bug fixes, its a mod i made for myself and decided i might as well upload.
body: o/ This was made in mcreator. this mod does what it says on the tin, it allows you to craft blue ice back into packed ice and packed ice into regular ice, its pretty simple. don't expect any updates, it works for 26.1.2, i dont know if it works for 26.1 or 26.1.1, it might, if you really want to know you can test it yourself. You can do what you want with the mod, modify it, completely change everything, use it, I don't really care, you don't have to give credit, basically, do what you want. I'd prefer if you didn't make money off it but whether you listen to that is up to you.
